sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想当年黑胶唱片时代的夜店打碟，每晚你都要带着300件最珍爱的宝贝去上班，把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个宛如精美50年历史文物的限时快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》播客，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, five days after the story of Cambridge Analytica broke,
sentences.zh: 今天距离剑桥分析公司丑闻曝光已经过去五天了，

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg finally breaks his silence about Facebook's role in the data breach and talks to The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格终于打破沉默，就Facebook在数据泄露事件中的角色发声，并接受了《纽约时报》的采访。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月22日，星期四。

sentences.en: It's no exaggeration to say that Facebook is in crisis, and that is a big statement.
sentences.zh: 毫不夸张地说，Facebook正陷入危机，这可不是小事。

sentences.en: There's a crisis at Facebook that is intensifying after the company failed to protect user data.
sentences.zh: 在公司未能保护用户数据后，Facebook内部的危机正在加剧。

sentences.en: The hashtag delete Facebook began trending after news of the data leak became public.
sentences.zh: 随着数据泄露的新闻公之于众，“删除Facebook”的标签开始流行。

sentences.en: People were upset.
sentences.zh: 人们感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Their profiles were sold to a company that helped the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们的个人资料被卖给了一家协助特朗普竞选的公司。

sentences.en: Some of their anger targeted at Facebook's
sentences.zh: 他们的怒火部分指向了Facebook的

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格。

sentences.en: He has been silent on the data leak, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少在数据泄露这件事上，他一直保持沉默。

sentences.en: If you look at Zuckerberg, he's MIA.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看扎克伯格，他简直就像失联了一样。

sentences.en: When was the last time we heard Zuckerberg talk about this?
sentences.zh: 我们上次听到扎克伯格谈论此事是什么时候？

sentences.en: It's a complete and utter failure of leadership.
sentences.zh: 这是领导力的彻底失败。

sentences.en: CEO Mark Zuckerberg is still missing in action.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格依然不知所踪。

sentences.en: We're all asking, where in the world is Mark Zuckerberg in this moment of crisis?
sentences.zh: 我们都在问，在这个危机时刻，马克·扎克伯格究竟在哪里？

sentences.en: He's got to make a clear statement, and soon.
sentences.zh: 他必须发表明确的声明，而且要快。

sentences.en: Surely, it's time for him to drop this pie-in-the-sky, fix-the-whole-world dreaming, and fix his company.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，是时候让他放弃那些不切实际、拯救世界的幻想，好好整顿他的公司了。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, minutes after breaking his silence by posting a public statement on Facebook,
sentences.zh: 周三下午，就在他在Facebook上发表公开声明打破沉默几分钟后，

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg got on the phone with my colleagues,
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格与我的同事

sentences.en: Kevin Roos and Shira Frankel.
sentences.zh: 凯文·鲁斯和希拉·弗兰克尔通了电话。

sentences.en: Kevin, how did this interview come to be?
sentences.zh: 凯文，这次采访是怎么促成的？

sentences.en: We had been asking Facebook for days about how they were going to respond, and we were just hearing nothing back.
sentences.zh: 我们连续几天一直在询问Facebook将如何回应，但始终杳无音讯。

sentences.en: I mean, they were saying, you know, something's coming, something's coming.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们一直在说，你知道的，事情要来了，事情要来了。

sentences.en: This is very unusual for something to go, I think it was five days, without any kind of public comment from either Mark Zuckerberg or Sheryl Sandberg, the COO of Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我认为长达五天时间里，无论是马克·扎克伯格还是Facebook首席运营官谢丽尔·桑德伯格都没有任何公开评论，这非常罕见。

sentences.en: And I had sort of given up on hearing directly from the company.
sentences.zh: 而且我差不多已经放弃直接从公司听到消息的念头了。

sentences.en: And then this afternoon, I was like sitting on my couch, and I got a call that says, can you talk to Mark Zuckerberg in five minutes?
sentences.zh: 结果就在今天下午，我正坐在沙发上，突然接到一个电话说：“你能在五分钟内和马克·扎克伯格通话吗？”

sentences.en: In five minutes?
sentences.zh: 五分钟？

sentences.en: Yeah, this was not the most heads-up
sentences.zh: 对，这次采访给的准备时间

sentences.en: I've ever had for an interview.
sentences.zh: 是我经历过最短的一次。

sentences.en: But my colleague, Shira Frankel, and I jumped on the phone and called into a conference line, and there was Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 但我和我的同事希拉·弗兰克尔立刻拿起电话拨入了一个会议专线，马克·扎克伯格就在那里。

sentences.en: And it's a pretty rare thing.
sentences.zh: 这相当罕见。

sentences.en: I mean, this is not a guy who gives a ton of interviews and is usually very tightly controlled in what he says to the public.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这家伙不怎么接受采访，而且通常对公众说的话控制得非常严密。

sentences.en: So how do you start the conversation with him?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么开始和他的对话呢？

sentences.en: What's your first question?
sentences.zh: 你的第一个问题是什么？

sentences.en: Well, our first question is, can we have a few minutes to read this post that you just put up on your Facebook page?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们的第一个问题是：能给我们几分钟时间阅读一下你刚在Facebook主页上发布的这条动态吗？

sentences.en: So we literally sat there for a few minutes on the phone, just with dead air, while Shira and I furiously read his Facebook poSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的在电话里安静地坐了几分钟，在一片沉默中，我和希拉狂热地阅读着他的Facebook动态。

sentences.en: Okay, so having read what Zuckerberg wrote on Facebook, what did you most want to ask him on the phone?
sentences.zh: 好吧，在读完扎克伯格在Facebook上写的内容后，你在电话里最想问他什么？

sentences.en: So we asked him first about the reaction and why it had taken so long for him to make any kind of public statement after this news came out about Cambridge Analytica.
sentences.zh: 所以我们首先问了他关于各方的反应，以及在剑桥分析公司的消息曝光后，他为什么花了这么长时间才发表任何形式的公开声明。

sentences.en: And, you know, he said, I really wanted to make sure we had a full understanding of everything that happened.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他说：“我真的很想确保我们对发生的一切有了全面的了解。”

sentences.en: We wanted to be able to fix the system, or at least try to fix the system.
sentences.zh: “我们希望能够修复系统，或者至少尝试修复系统。”

sentences.en: We wanted to have a plan in place to make it harder for developers to access this kind of data.
sentences.zh: “我们希望制定一个计划，让开发者更难获取这类数据。”

sentences.en: And we wanted to develop a tool.
sentences.zh: “我们还想开发一个工具。”

sentences.en: We wanted to give people a way to know whether their data was shared with Cambridge Analytica.
sentences.zh: “我们希望为人们提供一种途径，让他们知道自己的数据是否被分享给了剑桥分析公司。”

sentences.en: And he said there's a question of, it's not exactly that easy because not only did this app collect the data of the people who installed it, but it collected the data
sentences.zh: 他说这其中存在一个问题，事情并没有那么简单，因为这个应用不仅收集了安装它的人的数据，还收集了

sentences.en: of all of their Facebook friends, too.
sentences.zh: 他们所有Facebook好友的数据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in order to determine whose data was exposed, you have to rebuild people's Facebook networks as they looked in, you know, 2013 or 2014 when this was going on.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了确定哪些人的数据被泄露，你必须重建人们在2013年或2014年事发时的Facebook好友网络。

sentences.en: And people could have deleted friends, people could have stopped being friends with somebody, so it might not be actually all that feasible.
sentences.zh: 人们可能已经删除了好友，或者不再与某人是好友，所以这实际上可能并非完全可行。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, we're going to be conservative on this.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，我们在这方面会持谨慎态度。

sentences.en: We're going to try to tell anyone whose data was affected, even if we don't know for certain that it was.
sentences.zh: 我们要努力通知每一个数据可能受到影响的人，即使我们无法百分之百确定。

sentences.en: And what are you making of this plan he's laying out to kind of fix this data breach?
sentences.zh: 你对这次他为解决数据泄露而提出的计划怎么看？

sentences.en: I think that the most important thing that they're doing is limiting the amount of data and the number of developers who can get access to data.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们正在做的最重要的事情，就是限制数据量以及能够访问数据的开发者数量。

sentences.en: So for a while on Facebook, they were really, really permissive about what they would allow people to get who were building apps on top of Facebook.
sentences.zh: 因此在有一段时间里，Facebook对于构建应用的人可以获取什么权限，态度非常非常宽容。

sentences.en: So if you built an app, you know, a quiz, which Harry Potter character are you?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你开发了一个应用，比如一个小测验：你是《哈利·波特》里的哪个角色？

sentences.en: And it plugged into Facebook and you got people to install it.
sentences.zh: 它接入了Facebook，你引诱人们去安装它。

sentences.en: You could get a tremendous amount of information about those Facebook users through that app.
sentences.zh: 通过这个应用，你可以获得关于这些Facebook用户的巨量信息。

sentences.en: And they did actually tighten this up back in 2015.
sentences.zh: 他们在2015年确实收紧了这一政策。

sentences.en: They made it a little bit more challenging for app developers to get that kind of data.
sentences.zh: 他们提高了应用开发者获取此类数据的难度。

sentences.en: But before then, it was really a sort of free-for-all.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，这里真的就像一个自由市场。

sentences.en: That resulted in a lot of developers having access to a lot of people's data.
sentences.zh: 这导致许多开发者获取了大量用户的数据。

sentences.en: And the hard thing for Facebook now is that they don't know where all that data is.
sentences.zh: 现在对Facebook来说困难的是，他们不知道所有这些数据都在哪里。

sentences.en: I mean, they don't have it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们手里已经没有了。

sentences.en: It's with these app developers.
sentences.zh: 这些数据在那些应用开发者手里。

sentences.en: And so what Zuckerberg said was that they are going to do an investigation, not only of the apps that are currently asking for a lot of people's data on Facebook,
sentences.zh: 所以扎克伯格说，他们不仅要调查目前在Facebook上索取大量用户数据的应用，

sentences.en: but the apps that previous to this 2015 change that asked for a lot of people's Facebook data and investigate how that data was used and collected and try to figure out
sentences.zh: 还要调查2015年政策更改之前索取大量Facebook用户数据的应用，调查这些数据是如何被使用和收集的，并试图弄清楚

sentences.en: if there are any more Cambridge Analyticas out there.
sentences.zh: 是否还有其他类似剑桥分析公司的事件存在。

sentences.en: That sounds like a huge amount of work to investigate thousands of apps that collected this kind of data.
sentences.zh: 调查数千个收集这类数据的应用，听起来是一项极其庞大的工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: He said it would be thousands of apps and that they were going to have to hire additional people probably to do this.
sentences.zh: 他说这涉及数千个应用，为了完成这项工作，他们可能不得不招聘更多的人。

sentences.en: But I think he knows that there is this sort of amount of data out there that they can't really control.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他清楚，外面存在着这种他们无法真正控制的数据量。

sentences.en: I mean, they can ask developers to delete it after the fact, but developers are under no obligation to delete the data that came out of Facebook
sentences.zh: 我是说，事后他们可以要求开发者删除，但开发者没有义务删除那些从Facebook获取的、

sentences.en: that people shared with them willingly.
sentences.zh: 人们自愿分享给他们的数据。

sentences.en: And it feels like one of the lessons of Cambridge Analytica from our colleague Matt Rosenberg is that even when a company says that they have deleted this kind of data,
sentences.zh: 我们的同事马特·罗森伯格指出，剑桥分析公司的教训之一似乎是，即便一家公司声称已经删除了这类数据，

sentences.en: there's not necessarily a guarantee that they have.
sentences.zh: 也不一定能保证他们真的照做了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, Cambridge Analytica did certify.
sentences.zh: 我是说，剑桥分析公司确实做出了保证。

sentences.en: They sent a form back to Facebook that said we've deleted this data that reportedly was not true.
sentences.zh: 他们给Facebook回传了一份表格，说他们已经删除了这些数据，据报道这并不是事实。

sentences.en: And so I think they're trying to work out a new sort of system for making sure that people's data is not being shared against their will.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们正在努力制定一套新系统，以确保人们的数据不会在违背意愿的情况下被分享。

sentences.en: You actually asked Zuckerberg about Cambridge Analytica and whether they were honest about what they did with this data.
sentences.zh: 你确实向扎克伯格问及了剑桥分析公司，以及他们在如何处理这些数据这件事上是否诚实。

sentences.en: And he seemed to acknowledge to you that the company had lied to Facebook, right?
sentences.zh: 他似乎向你承认了该公司对Facebook撒了谎，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He said it seems that that was false.
sentences.zh: 他说情况看起来确实是假的。

sentences.en: They haven't done a full investigation yet, so they don't actually know.
sentences.zh: 他们还没有进行彻底的调查，所以实际上并不知情。

sentences.en: But they have read reports, including the ones that ran in the New York Times last week, that journalists have seen this data.
sentences.zh: 但他们读过一些报道，包括《纽约时报》上周刊登的报道，记者们已经看到了这些数据。

sentences.en: And that, he said, was a strong enough signal for them to take action.
sentences.zh: 他说，这已经足以构成让他们采取行动的强烈信号了。

sentences.en: So after talking about Cambridge Analytica for a while, what do you guys ask Zuckerberg about?
sentences.zh: 所以在聊了一会儿剑桥分析公司之后，你们又问了扎克伯格什么？

sentences.en: So we asked him about all of the other threats to Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们问了他关于Facebook面临的所有其他威胁。

sentences.en: So Russia and foreign interference in the midterms later this year and what they were doing to prevent the platform from being exploited again.
sentences.zh: 比如俄罗斯和外国势力对今年晚些时候中期选举的干预，以及他们正在采取什么措施来防止该平台再次被利用。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, we're working on this.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，我们正在努力。

sentences.en: We have built some tools.
sentences.zh: 我们已经构建了一些工具。

sentences.en: We've seen that they work pretty well.
sentences.zh: 我们发现它们效果相当不错。

sentences.en: And then he broke some news.
sentences.zh: 然后他透露了一些重磅消息。

sentences.en: He said for the first time that in December of last year, when the special election in Alabama happened, they discovered that some Macedonian accounts
sentences.zh: 他首次透露，去年12月阿拉巴马州特别选举期间，他们发现一些马其顿账号

sentences.en: were trying to spread false news in the lead up to that election and that they were able to eliminate those.
sentences.zh: 试图在那场选举前期散布虚假新闻，而他们成功清除了这些账号。

sentences.en: And in addition to talking about the Macedonian interference, he said something really interesting about sort of false news as a category.
sentences.zh: 除了谈到马其顿的干预外，他还就“虚假新闻”这一类别发表了一些非常有趣的看法。

sentences.en: And he made a comparison to spam.
sentences.zh: 他将其与垃圾邮件进行了类比。

sentences.en: He said a lot of this is done by the same people who would have sent you emails about Viagra in the 90s.
sentences.zh: 他说，其中许多操作都是由90年代向你发送伟哥垃圾邮件的同一拨人完成的。

sentences.en: And now they're trying to come up with ways to push false and sensational news into your Facebook feed to try to get you to click on it so they can sell you ads.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们正想方设法将虚假和耸人听闻的新闻塞进你的Facebook信息流，诱使你点击，从而向你推销广告。

sentences.en: And I think that's partly true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这部分是真的。

sentences.en: I think that part of what motivates people to put sensational news on Facebook is this kind of spammy profit motive.
sentences.zh: 我认为促使人们在Facebook上发布轰动性新闻的部分原因，正是这种垃圾邮件式的暴利动机。

sentences.en: But there's this other part of it that I don't think he addressed, which is that a lot of people are doing this for motivated political reasons, not necessarily because
sentences.zh: 但还有另一部分他似乎没有提及，那就是许多人这样做是有政治动机的，不一定是因为

sentences.en: they're trying to make money.
sentences.zh: 他们想赚钱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Viagra never swayed an election, as best we can tell.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，伟哥从来没有左右过选举。

sentences.en: Not that we can tell, right?
sentences.zh: 至少据我们所知没有，对吧？

sentences.en: So is he underplaying the kind of nefarious ambition of fake news versus the economic motives of spam?
sentences.zh: 那么，他是故意淡化假新闻背后那种邪恶的政治野心，而强调垃圾邮件的经济动机吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there's a real political motive here that is really hard to defend against because if people aren't motivated by profits, then taking away the tools
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这里存在着真正的政治动机，而这很难防范，因为如果人们不是出于利润驱动，那么剥夺他们赚钱的工具

sentences.en: that allow them to make money isn't going to stop them from doing what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 并不能阻止他们继续作恶。

sentences.en: There's a moment in this interview, and I read the transcript of it, that I loved, and it felt very telling where Zuckerberg basically says to you, look, when I made Facebook
sentences.zh: 这次采访中有一个片段——我读过采访文稿——我非常喜欢，而且感觉很有深意：扎克伯格对你直言不讳地说，“听着，当我在2004年于哈佛的宿舍里创建Facebook时，我从未预料到会发生这一切。”

sentences.en: in my dorm room at Harvard in 2004, I never saw any of this coming.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我问了他这个问题，因为我一直很好奇他的感受，不仅仅是他在做什么，我是说，作为一个构建了这个庞大平台的人，而这个平台现在正以

sentences.en: Yeah, so I asked him, because I've been curious about how he feels, not just what he's doing, but, I mean, to be the person who built this enormous platform that is now changing
sentences.zh: 好的以及有时非常糟糕的方式改变着社会的结构。

sentences.en: the fabric of society in ways that are good and sometimes really bad.
sentences.zh: 总之我差不多是问：对于Facebook在全世界被这样使用，你感到内疚吗？

sentences.en: But in general, I sort of said, well, do you feel any guilt about how Facebook is being used all over the world?
sentences.zh: 他沉默了很长时间，最后开口时，他说：“你知道，我们在这里做的事情是前所未有的，有一些挑战

sentences.en: And he paused for a really long time, and then finally, when he spoke up, he said, you know, we're doing something here that has never been done before, and there are challenges
sentences.zh: 是我认为任何人都没有预料到的。”

sentences.en: that I don't think anyone had anticipated.

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是爱喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
